tool.name: DecodeModel
tool.description: : Evaluates a PyTorch autoencoder from the given properties.

param.name: input_model_pth_path
param.label: input PTH file
param.help: Path to the trained model file whose decoder will be used. Format: [input].pth

param.name: input_dataset_npy_path
param.label: input NPY file
param.help: Path to the input latent variables file in NumPy format (e.g. encoded 'z'). Format: [input].npy

param.name: outname_output_results_npz_path
param.label: output NPZ name
param.help: Path to the output reconstructed data file (compressed NumPy archive, typically containing 'xhat') Format: [output].npz

param.name: sele
param.label: Take tool settings:
param.help: Select where tool settings are to be read from

param.name: properties
param.label: Configuration file
param.help: File containing tool settings. See below for the syntax

param.name: jsonstr
param.label: JSON string
param.help: JSON string containing tool settings. See below for the syntax

param.name: Dataset
param.label: Dataset
param.help: DataLoader options (e.g. batch_size, shuffle) for batching the latent variables. (Json)
